entities.summary: Ryan Stevenson Crotty is a New Zealand-born former rugby union Rugby player. Crotty has previously played for the Crusaders in the Super Rugby competition and Canterbury in the ITM Cup, captaining both teams. He is currently an assistant coach for the Crusaders in Super Rugby.
